release_notes:
ReadySetPDF 4.0.8

File details for the highlighted asset, including page count, size, resolution, and whether a customer PDF needs a password to open. Locked intake files show (locked) in Assets Manager.

Unlock ReadySetPDF print and edit locks from the header, between Global Settings and Export Proof Images.

Color tab image controls: tone, chroma, and CMYK ink sliders, with Reset adjustments. The monitor updates as the sliders move.

Preflight criteria are grouped and labeled for press operators. Yes-or-no checks no longer show a number box.

Booklet padding uses the document page size when the page count is not a multiple of 4, and the preview warns when that count will not close a booklet.
